items.source: Specialization of @Component for classes that declare @ExceptionHandler, @InitBinder, or @ModelAttribute methods to be shared across multiple @Controller classes.
items.translation: 用于声明 `@ExceptionHandler`、`@InitBinder` 或 `@ModelAttribute` 方法的类的 `@Component` 特化，以便在多个 `@Controller` 类之间共享。

items.source: A shortcut annotation that combines @ControllerAdvice with @ResponseBody, in effect simply an @ControllerAdvice whose exception handler methods render to the response body.
items.translation: 一个快捷注解，结合了 `@ControllerAdvice` 与 `@ResponseBody`，实际上就是一个异常处理程序方法会渲染到响应体的`@ControllerAdvice`。

items.source: Marks a method or exception class with the status ResponseStatus.code() and ResponseStatus.reason() that should be returned.
items.translation: 标记方法或异常类，指定应返回的状态码 `ResponseStatus.code()` 和原因 `ResponseStatus.reason()`。

items.source: A convenience annotation that is itself annotated with @Controller and @ResponseBody.
items.translation: 一个便捷注解，其本身被@Controller和@ResponseBody注解。

items.source: Annotation that identifies methods that initialize the WebDataBinder which will be used for populating command and form object arguments of annotated handler methods.
items.translation: 用于标识初始化 WebDataBinder 的注解，该绑定器将用于填充带有注解的处理方法的命令和表单对象参数。

items.source: Annotation for mapping HTTP DELETE requests onto specific handler methods.
items.translation: 用于将 HTTP DELETE 请求映射到特定处理方法的注解。

items.source: Annotation for mapping HTTP GET requests onto specific handler methods.
items.translation: 用于将 HTTP GET 请求映射到特定处理方法的注解。

items.source: Annotation for mapping HTTP PATCH requests onto specific handler methods.
items.translation: 用于将 HTTP PATCH 请求映射到特定处理方法的注解。

items.source: Annotation for mapping HTTP POST requests onto specific handler methods.
items.translation: 用于将 HTTP POST 请求映射到特定处理方法的注解。

items.source: Annotation for mapping HTTP PUT requests onto specific handler methods.
items.translation: 用于将 HTTP PUT 请求映射到特定处理方法的注解。

items.source:
Annotations for binding requests to controllers and handler methods
as well as for binding request parameters to method arguments.
items.translation: 用于将请求绑定到控制器和处理器方法，以及将请求参数绑定到方法参数的注解。

items.source: Provides web-specific data binding functionality.
items.translation: 提供针对 Web 的数据绑定功能。

items.source: Support classes for web data binding.
items.translation: 支持 Web 数据绑定的类。

items.source:
Annotation to bind values from a web request such as request parameters or
path variables to fields of a Java object.
items.translation: 用于将 Web 请求（如请求参数或路径变量）中的值绑定到 Java 对象字段的注解。

items.source: Annotation to indicate that a method parameter is bound to an HTTP cookie.
items.translation: 用于指示方法参数绑定到 HTTP 饼干的注解。

items.source:
Annotation for permitting cross-origin requests on specific handler classes
and/or handler methods.
items.translation: 用于允许特定处理器类和/或处理器方法处理跨域请求的注解。

items.source:
Annotation for handling exceptions in specific handler classes and/or
handler methods.
items.translation: 用于在特定处理器类和/或处理器方法中处理异常的注解。

items.source: Meta annotation that indicates a web mapping annotation.
items.translation: 指示 Web 映射注解的元注解。

items.source:
Annotation which indicates that a method parameter should be bound to a
name-value pair within a path segment.
items.translation: 指示应将方法参数绑定到路径段中的名称 - 值对的注解。

items.source:
Annotation that binds a method parameter or method return value
to a named model attribute, exposed to a web view.
items.translation: 绑定方法参数或方法返回值到命名模型属性的注解，该属性暴露给 Web 视图。

items.source:
Annotation which indicates that a method parameter should be bound to a URI template
variable.
items.translation: 指示应将方法参数绑定到 URI 模板变量的注解。

items.source: Annotation to bind a method parameter to a request attribute.
items.translation: 用于将方法参数绑定到请求属性的注解。

items.source: Annotation indicating a method parameter should be bound to the body of the web request.
items.translation: 注解，指示应将方法参数绑定到 Web 请求的主体。

items.source: Annotation which indicates that a method parameter should be bound to a web request header.
items.translation: 指示应将方法参数绑定到 Web 请求头的注解。

items.source:
Annotation for mapping web requests onto methods in request-handling classes
with flexible method signatures.
items.translation: 用于将 Web 请求映射到具有灵活方法签名的请求处理类的方法的注解。

items.source: Enumeration of HTTP request methods.
items.translation: HTTP 请求方法的枚举。

items.source:
Annotation which indicates that a method parameter should be bound to a web
request parameter.
items.translation: 指示应将方法参数绑定到 Web 请求参数的注解。

items.source:
Annotation that can be used to associate the part of a "multipart/form-data" request
with a method argument.
items.translation: 可用于将“multipart/form-data”请求的部分与方法参数关联的注解。

items.source:
Annotation that indicates a method return value should be bound to the web
response body.
items.translation: 指示方法返回值应绑定到 Web 响应体的注解。

items.source: Annotation to bind a method parameter to a session attribute.
items.translation: 用于将方法参数绑定到会话属性的注解。

items.source: Annotation that indicates the session attributes that a specific handler uses.
items.translation: 指示特定处理器使用的会话属性的注解。

items.source: Common value constants shared between bind annotations.
items.translation: 绑定注解之间共享的公共值常量。
